info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Knowledge Exchange API
info.description: The Knowledge Exchange API enables businesses to update and manage their banking knowledge assets efficiently. This endpoint allows users to modify specific knowledge assets identified by a unique parameter, enhancing the accuracy and relevance of accessible information. It is tailored for financial institutions and developers involved in knowledge management, ensuring that users can keep their data current and aligned with industry standards. Utilize this API to streamline knowledge asset updates and improve resource sharing across your organization.

patch.summary: Update a specific knowledge exchange resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the attributes of a specific knowledge exchange resource identified by RES-100045. Utilize this endpoint to modify details related to knowledge sharing, ensuring the latest information is accurately reflected.
